name: jev
description: Cheap, fast, typed AI judgments inside Claude Code via the jevctl CLI (verify, screen, find, classify, extract, rerank, match, route, ask, batch), plus verbatim Jev-guided context compaction that replaces the built-in summary.

compaction.title: Jev compaction
compaction.description: Replace Claude Code's compaction summary with Jev-guided verbatim compaction (requires CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 and TYPESAFE_API_KEY).

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment or settings env.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or result is still needed.

compactAtPercent.title: Auto-compact at context %
compactAtPercent.description: turn.complete requests compaction once context usage reaches this percentage. 0 disables auto-compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction
minReductionRatio.description: Fall back to the built-in summary when the estimated reduction is below this ratio.

maxStateTokens.title: Max state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation history sent to Jev with every request. Fitted in stages, never summarized.

maxRequestTokens.title: Max request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for history plus one batch of questions; more questions mean more requests.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: TypeSafe Jev model name, e.g. jev-latest or a pinned jev-1.13.0.
